paper_title: OVTR: End-to-End Open-Vocabulary Multiple Object Tracking with Transformer
official_binding: Official ICLR accepted PDF firstpage explicitly links jinyanglii/OVTR; author arxiv release also binds repo. Current pinned main not exact local checkpoints/paper numerical replication.
license: MIT2025JinyangLi root read; derivative MOTR/DeformableDETR/GroundingDINO headers retained in source and not treated as permission to discard upstream attributions. No copying/imports here.
paper_read_scope: Arxiv main intro/relatedwork/method3.1-3.5/experiments4.1-4.5/conclusion, appendixA-D textual method/implementation/experiments. Official acceptedPDF firstpage venue/repo binding separately read. Not all plots/qualitative figures visually or a line-by-line accepted-versus-arxiv equivalence check.
original_task: Physical open-vocabulary MOT with known and novel category text embeddings provided, not discovering unnamed semantic categories across videos.
model_inputs: Current image, ResNet50/multiscale features, provided CLIP category text embeddings, learned900detect queries and previous physical-track query content/refboxes. Offline Train has image-sequence GTboxes/labels/instanceIDs and category-mean CLIP image distillation targets.
model_outputs: Frame category logits/boxes, OFA aligned embedding, CTI semantic embedding and per-video physical IDs/query state.
losses: Matched and maintained physical queries have sigmoid focal category loss2(alpha.25,gamma2), boxL1=5, GIoU=2, normalized predicted-embedding to category-image-embedding MSEalignment=2, auxiliary decoder losses. Actual loss_align sums512dimensions then dividesbyobjectcount; paperEq1 divides byn*d. No autonomous category discovery/WAIT or corruption correction loss.
training_protocol: Offline LVIS processedimages/HDF5 plus artificial sameimage sequences/dynamicMosaic/randomocclusion, image2/3/4/5 at sampler steps4/7/14; current script first1epoch with pretrain2e-4(backbone2e-5), then second call16epochs4e-5(backbone4e-6), AdamWwd1e-4,clip.1. Frozen backbone/encoder and selected detector keys; updater/decoder-training rules. Main train loop saves everyepoch and no active Val-best selection shown. Actual annotation/checkpoint assets never opened.
online_or_offline: Offline supervised synthetic-sequence Train; current-image/past query physical inference; default completed-track formatting retrospectively votes categories.
causal_or_noncausal: inference_single_image reads current imgs[0] and previous queries, resets at frame0; GT label field included by native val loader but not referenced in this inspected inference path. Native generic forward always consumes gt_instances and computes fullclip GTclasscount; it is not a pure legal online API. Static callgraph is not an actual GT/future/ID mutation certificate.
state_memory: Per-video physical query content256/refbox/disappear counters/semantic index; CIP aggregates current OFA features plus currenttrack content with selfattention/residualMLP. No across-video anonymous category event bank, WAIT/versionedrollback/corrective removal.
evaluation: Sequential native validation loader, per-source-domain filename selects threshold/miss/IoU settings, confidence/area filtering, external TETA after native TaoDataset fulltrack majority_vote tcc=true. Val shell references Liteconfig with5frameweights; currentcfg test dictionary points tovalidation_ours_v1.json. Variabletest/publicpaper Testtables do not authorize TAOTest assets; none accessed.
contract_rejections: Text features influence encoder top900 proposal ranking, decoder CTI and later-layer attention isolation. OFA output is not vocabulary-independent simply because its own branch precedes textcrossattention in the currentlayer: earlierdecoderlayer CTI query content and text-ranked proposals already affect it.
Text-loaded category logits produce tracking scores and threshold decisions; deleting class outputs does not yield anonymous foreground/calibration purity.
Category isolation uses KL between supplied-text category distributions; cannot use Novelvocabulary or split knowledge in TrackOCD.

Current config training uses allLVISclass list and builds ignore_ids for rareclasses, but inspected _parse_ann_info does not applyignore_ids. Known-only claim therefore depends on processed annotation/content lineage, not filename/sourceprint.
Native val dataset reads GT category labels into inputs; inspected image-only inference does not consume those fields. Must externalizeobserver and run actual mutation before calling pure.
Wholetrack majority_vote rewrites earlier categories using future predictions; native formatted results are not causal category memory.
static_source_paper_differences_not_exec: Paper encoder multimodal prefusion exists as optionalmodule; current5frameconfig use_fusion_layer=false, so actualencoder bypasses BiAttentionBlock. Record implementation/config distinction.

Paper firstdecoder-layer content isolation: actual transformerforward290-296 leaves this mask commented and initializesNone. Later-layer categoryKLmask exists; this is not both paper strategies implemented on selectedpath.

Main parser args.eval defaults truthy['track']; resume optimizer/scheduler/start_epoch restoration is guarded by notargs.eval. With the inspected train script, second call restores model weights but the guard does not restore optimizer/epoch; static path finding, no upstream run or silentfix.
Paper main16epoch4e-5 schedule differs current script1epoch2e-4 plus16call; restored-state caveat affects whether this is intended fine-tuning or exactcontinuation. No paper replication asserted.
Paper alignmentMSE averages n*d; actual normalized prediction squaredsum/objectcount withlossweight2 changes scale.
Native eval selects7source-domain score/IoU/miss profiles from file_path string and sets KLratio5 versus decoderTrain10; these are not our frozen ID-free input contract.
Currentconfidence=maxsigmoidcategory not provedobjectness; anonymous frozenforeground contract needed.
Missing _track_discard/keep_indices variables on train_with_artificial_img_seqs=false branch are static compatibility caveats; currentconfig flagtrue, so not asserted failures of activepath.
Legacytorch1.10/MMCV/mmdet/detectron2/deformable CUDA requirements not installed or executed; existingA100/masa environments do not automatically qualify this code.
paper_limitations_summary: Provided-vocabulary OVMOT, source-domain inference profiles, annotation-cadence benchmarking and no reversible cross-video category lifecycle. Novel recognition via provided text is different from semantic category discovery. These are audit task/protocol limits, not claimed author explicit limitations.
TrackOCD_root_connection: Disentangled physical/localization and semantic representations plus current/past query state are hypothesis sources for geometrycollapse and stability diagnostics. Native source does not supply lawful anonymous semantic targets or correct persistent-memory corruption.
what_to_borrow: Independently qualify current/past visual-state representations and category-versus-instance gradient/geometry controls; bounded candidate-conditioned memory mechanisms without semantic text or GTforward.
what_not_to_borrow: Provided Novelnames/text, native domain-string hyperparameter selection, fulltrackcategory voting, physical-ID-as-semanticcategory, or copying a vocabulary-conditioned OFA branch and declaring it anonymous.
requires_before_qualified_import: Vocabulary-free frozen current-frame inputs and actual ID/GT/future mutation checks
